clm-explorio-biome-todo-attributes.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-biome-todo-attributes.text: The GDD's biome to-do list includes biome size (Large, Small, Unique Layer), a Normal/Hard version, and whether a biome can be an end-point/boss biome.

clm-explorio-brogue-key-chains.text: Brogue builds key chains by outsourcing a feature's item to another machine that adopts it (MF_OUTSOURCE_ITEM_TO_MACHINE, BP_ADOPT_ITEM).

clm-explorio-brogue-level-gen-target.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-brogue-level-gen-target.text: The misc-ideas doc names Brogue as the level generation quality Explorio wants to achieve.

evidence.locator: Statuses; Damage over time: > Types > Constant

clm-explorio-burning-wet-plant-rules.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-burning-wet-plant-rules.text: Burning is removed by applying Wet, may spread fire to nearby objects and characters, and its duration can be refreshed only by a plant-type effect.

clm-explorio-cape-movement-skill.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-cape-movement-skill.text: The cape slot holds one active or passive skill, such as a movement skill with cooldown (dodge, dash, blink), and capes and cape skills are listed as a possible vertical meta unlock.

clm-explorio-centurion-energy-cell.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-centurion-energy-cell.text: The dwarven Centurion guards important rooms and is powered by a steam or energy cell that can be used to open doors.

clm-explorio-cloaks-cooldown-not-charges.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-cloaks-cooldown-not-charges.text: GDD 03 cloaks are used on a cooldown instead of limited charges, giving movement or protection skills such as blink, dash, burrow and short invisibility.

clm-explorio-compound-puzzle-trigger.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-compound-puzzle-trigger.text: GDD 06 says compound puzzles (on-site clues incomplete, extra clue or tool needed) can be generated when a puzzle with all its keys is locked behind another lock.

clm-explorio-critters-nonaggressive.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-critters-nonaggressive.text: Critters do not attack unless attacked or approached, mostly do not chase a fleeing player, and many flee from bright light, pointy weapons or the death of pack-mates.

clm-explorio-crowbar-lockpick-break-chan.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-crowbar-lockpick-break-chan.text: In GDD 03 both the crowbar and lockpicks open locked doors and chests and each has a chance to break.

clm-explorio-curses-lifted-by-condition.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-curses-lifted-by-condition.text: GDD 05 proposes curses lifted by a specific place or a repeated action, with a run or class starting fully cursed so the dungeon can be generated around the player's curses.

clm-explorio-cyclic-reduces-backtracking.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-cyclic-reduces-backtracking.text: GDD 02 states that leaning dungeon generation towards cyclic design reduces backtracking because each side objective returns the player to the main path.

clm-explorio-decision-biome-names-deferr.text: The biome-name mismatch between code and design docs will be fixed later.

evidence.locator: story layout is forced into room map with empty rooms getting standalone stuff

location.anchor: Generation order: story graph first, forced into a room map

clm-explorio-decision-graph-first-into-r.text: The story graph is generated first and forced into a room map; rooms it does not use get standalone content.

evidence.locator: you can cross the chasm, but can't float upwards to go back to the previous layer

location.anchor: Levitation crosses chasms, but cannot rise a layer

clm-explorio-decision-levitation-crosses.text: Levitation can cross a chasm but cannot float upwards to the previous layer.

evidence.locator: no short way back is ok

location.anchor: Point of no return and Burning bridges: no short way back

clm-explorio-decision-no-short-way-back.text: Point of no return and Burning bridges mean no short way back; a long way back must still exist.

evidence.locator: any layout with drop needs a accesible path to stairs back up

location.anchor: Every one-way link needs a way back

clm-explorio-decision-way-back-after-one.text: Every drop needs an accessible way back up; the way back may cross locks whose keys are reachable from the landing, and a config option can limit it to locks that can't be failed (no wastable consumable keys).

evidence.locator: wave function collapse is wave function collapse. We can do both

location.anchor: Wave Function Collapse is used for both

clm-explorio-decision-wfc-both-uses.text: Wave Function Collapse is to be used both for geometry and for abstract-to-concrete content.

clm-explorio-dex-xp-for-locks.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-dex-xp-for-locks.text: Opening locks and puzzles earns experience in the Dexterity meta talent tree.

location.anchor: Lock and key properties – match with the sheet

clm-explorio-dormans-lock-properties.text: Dormans lists key properties (reusable/consumable, perishable, physical/abstract) and lock properties (conditional, permanent/timed, relockable, unidirectional, unsafe).

clm-explorio-enemy-generation-pipeline.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-enemy-generation-pipeline.text: GDD 02 determines enemies as Environment → Encounter → possible enemy pool → enemy, stacking stats by type, variant, class (e.g. Boss) and random gear.

clm-explorio-fifteen-classes.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-fifteen-classes.text: GDD 05 lists 15 classes: 4 base, 6 advanced and 5 challenging, the challenging ones unlocked by achievements.

clm-explorio-five-room-biome-template.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-five-room-biome-template.text: GDD 02 proposes the Five Room Dungeon (Entrance and Guardian; Puzzle or Challenge; Setback or Red Herring; Climactic Battle or Challenge; Reward, Revelation and Plot Twist) as the structure of each biome, with the Setback room as a place for a one-way entrance to a neighbouring biome.

clm-explorio-friendly-mimic-key.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-friendly-mimic-key.text: The Friendly mimic key opens, at a cost of 1-5 HP, any door the player is missing exactly one key for; doors with several keyholes open only if just one key is missing.

clm-explorio-guard-dog-boss-three-keys.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-guard-dog-boss-three-keys.text: GDD 02 lists a 'guard dog' main-boss pattern in which the boss is locked behind 3 keys spread throughout the neighbouring regions.

clm-explorio-key-burden-returns.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-key-burden-returns.text: In the Key burden pattern the key is far from its lock, burdens the carrier with a debuff or chasing enemies, and the burden ends when the key is returned.

clm-explorio-keyless-first-boss.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-keyless-first-boss.text: The achievement 'Where Did I Put My Keys?' requires defeating the first boss without using a single key and rewards the Prisoner class.

clm-explorio-keys-indestructible.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-keys-indestructible.text: The Magma Slime melts swallowed metal items but can only destroy basic items, not keys.

clm-explorio-keys-section-empty.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-keys-section-empty.text: The Keys section of GDD 03 contains only a link to a thread on procedurally generated keys, with no key item design.

clm-explorio-layer-descent-items.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-layer-descent-items.text: GDD 03's rope lets the player jump to the lower depth without taking damage.

clm-explorio-levitation-vs-flying-terrai.notes: GDD 04 says levitation cannot cross chasms; the owner decided on 2026-11-23 that it can, but cannot rise a layer. The decision wins for design.
clm-explorio-levitation-vs-flying-terrai.text: Levitation and Flying both avoid triggering pressure plates; Levitation can cross deep water but not chasms, while Flying can cross both; a net grounds a flyer but not a levitating character.

clm-explorio-lock-generalised.text: Locks and keys are abstract roles: enemies, tools, consumables and environment effects can act as keys or locks.

clm-explorio-lock-grammar-as-room-purpos.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-lock-grammar-as-room-purpos.text: GDD 06 files Lock and Key Grammar under room purpose classification methods, next to 5 Room Dungeon and Cycle Based Generation, while Wave Function Collapse is listed as a walkable-area generation method.

clm-explorio-lorekeeper-gate-exits.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-lorekeeper-gate-exits.text: The Lorekeeper's gate closes behind the player and reopens either by defeating the Lorekeeper or by activating two timed wall buttons; escaping by the buttons permanently closes the gate, leaving only Teleportation Magic to return.

clm-explorio-lure-lever-example.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-lure-lever-example.text: The bestiary's lure-and-deterrence examples include throwing a deterrent through bars so an enemy pulls a lever that opens all doors of the room, and luring a sleeping rat off a pressure plate with cheese.

clm-explorio-magic-limited-usage.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-magic-limited-usage.text: Magic is meant as a limited-usage tool for monsters and most classes: non-magical players use charged spellcasting foci as consumables, and magic-focused characters charge staves with mana.

clm-explorio-matrix-coverage.text: The product sheet has 94 distinct rows for 96 possible combinations, with 25 named archetypes.

clm-explorio-matrix-missing-cells.text: Consumable-XOR-Permanent-Required/Optional-Closed and Reusable-XNOR-Permanent-Required/Optional-Closed are missing from the sheet.

clm-explorio-mimic-boss-two-layers.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-mimic-boss-two-layers.text: A Mimic boss zone generates two layers, one below the other, with identical layout but different machines; a secret entrance on one layer can be a trap on the other.

location.anchor: Hard requirements stated in the doc

clm-explorio-mimic-lab-only.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-mimic-lab-only.text: The chest mimic is the only mimic type that can appear outside the laboratory.

clm-explorio-no-in-run-xp.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-no-in-run-xp.text: GDD 05 says the character should not gain experience in a run (improving through items and potions instead), while it places experience sources under Meta Progression talent trees.

evidence.locator: Other similar games > Noita > Interesting effects

clm-explorio-oil-chasm-parkour.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-oil-chasm-parkour.text: An oil-like status that removes floor traction is proposed as part of a parkour challenge on a narrow passage between chasms.

clm-explorio-only-p1-implemented.notes: Outdated on 2026-11-26: all productions P1a-P9 are implemented in lock_and_key_productions/rules.py.
clm-explorio-only-p1-implemented.text: Only production 1 is implemented in dev, as L1 and L2 with fixed AND/LOCKED/PERMANENT/MANDATORY attributes.

clm-explorio-p4-p5-swapped.text: The sheet numbers Ambush at the Gate as production 4 and Tripwire trap as 5; the productions doc numbers Tripwire 4 and Ambush 5.

clm-explorio-paralysis-immunity.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-paralysis-immunity.text: Paralysis blocks inventory access, a second application stuns, and the character gains immunity to paralysis when it ends.

clm-explorio-player-verb-set.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-player-verb-set.text: The player's control verbs include grab entity, crouch/investigate (one button), interact, main and alternative use per hand, a quick slot for self-use, and a cape skill with hold-to-sprint on the same button.

evidence.locator: Other similar games > Noita > Interesting effects

clm-explorio-rain-scroll-puddles.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-rain-scroll-puddles.text: A rain effect, possibly a scroll spell, is proposed to create water puddles and extinguish open fire.

clm-explorio-rations-as-lures.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-rations-as-lures.text: GDD 03 gives rations non-food uses: cheese lures rats, meat lures carnivores, fruit can be traded with a monkey, garlic fends off vampires and bats, and a fortune cookie gives clues.

clm-explorio-regional-power-collectibles.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-regional-power-collectibles.text: GDD 02 proposes biome-specific collectibles that raise the player's power only inside that biome, so each biome stays somewhat difficult after heavy earlier exploration.

clm-explorio-room-types-eight.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-room-types-eight.text: GDD 06 defines eight room types for layout: Room, Tunnel, Clearance, Cavern, Shelter, Relic, Barrier and Plaza, each with a shape primitive (e.g. Clearance as a giant cellular-automata blob or walker).

clm-explorio-rune-vs-enchantment-reuse.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-rune-vs-enchantment-reuse.text: In GDD 03 a weapon enchantment is used up in combat, while a rune is an enchantment that is not used up.

clm-explorio-scrolls-need-identification.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-scrolls-need-identification.text: GDD 03 scrolls must be identified, through high Magic Knowledge, by using them, or by finding books about them.

clm-explorio-seed-save-metadata.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-seed-save-metadata.text: The proposed seed save stores a list of map seeds with the game version and date of each seed's creation in a text file, and shows recent or all seeds in an in-game menu.

clm-explorio-six-dot-types.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-six-dot-types.text: GDD 04 defines six damage-over-time mechanic types: percentage, decreasing, increasing, constant, evenly from pool, and ticking bomb.

clm-explorio-six-elements.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-six-elements.text: Explorio's cosmology has six elements (Earth, Water, Air, Fire, Wild, Power), each with positive, negative and neutral alignments.

location.anchor: Hard requirements stated in the doc

clm-explorio-slime-encounter-requirement.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-slime-encounter-requirement.text: The Blood Slime requires a necromancy or vampires encounter and the Holy Water Slime requires a sacral or werewolves encounter.

clm-explorio-slime-key-carrier.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-slime-key-carrier.text: Slimes can carry a key inside them; when a slime splits the key may drop (and be swallowed again by another slime) or pass to a smaller slime.

clm-explorio-slime-size-split.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-slime-size-split.text: A larger slime splits into at most two slimes of the next size, or one of the next size plus two of the size below; stone, golden and titan slimes do not split.

clm-explorio-spell-schools-list.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-spell-schools-list.text: GDD 04 names six base spell schools (Pyromancy, Water, Power, Air, Earth, Wild) and three quasi elements (Wood, Metal, Magma); only Water has any content.

clm-explorio-tests-broken.notes: Outdated: epic part 1 (PR #3) replaced the master-era tests; pytest passes.
clm-explorio-tests-broken.text: Tests and examples on dev import the productions package that dev deleted.

location.anchor: Three acts and bosses A, B, C

clm-explorio-three-act-bosses.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-three-act-bosses.text: GDD 02 structures a run in three acts with one main boss each (A, B, C), where act 1 should work standalone and the final boss climax builds on mechanics from previous lairs.

clm-explorio-three-bosses-per-run.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-three-bosses-per-run.text: A run contains up to three bosses and several layers.

clm-explorio-trap-intent-three.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-trap-intent-three.text: GDD 06 splits traps by intent into three types: traps that lure, traps that deter and traps that alarm.

evidence.locator: Other similar games > Unexplored; Game Menu Features > Seed Save

clm-explorio-unexplored-game-to-beat.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-unexplored-game-to-beat.text: The misc-ideas doc calls Unexplored 'the game we want to kill' and uses it as the model for three default save slots.

clm-explorio-vocabulary-drift.text: Code enums use LOCKED/UNLOCKED, MANDATORY/MISSABLE/FAILABLE and MAIN where sheet and doc use Closed/Open, Required/Optional/Failable and PRIMARY.

clm-explorio-wet-element-reactions.notes: Drafted by a reading agent; anchors and key facts spot-checked against the source.
clm-explorio-wet-element-reactions.text: A Wet character hit by an Electric spell takes double damage and becomes Electrified, by a Fire spell takes half damage and creates a steam cloud, and by a Cold spell is stunned and becomes Frozen; it loses Wet in each case.

clm-explorio-wfc-empty.text: The WFC/machines module on dev is an empty dict.
